name: 01. MSU-L20S15-07 Report test New Dry UV Machine 395nm ( Normal 365nm) date 2.05.2025 - Copy_1778470633

doc.title: MSU-L20S15-07 - New Dry UV 395nm machine vs Normal 365nm (BRS-161016 + MSU-L20S15-07)
doc.purpose: Verify whether 395nm Dry UV machine produces tension equal to or better than Normal 365nm machine on BRS-161016 and MSU-L20S15-07.
content: 161016: UV peak 395nm 11-33 (with film), 53-65 (no film) vs Normal 365nm peak 117-872. Tension 1.3103 (Test) vs 1.374 (Normal) spec 0.5 PASS both.
201507: Test 395nm peak 2-3 (with film) / 53-65 (no film) vs Normal 365nm peak 19-464. Tension 1st 2.875 (Test) vs 2.503 (Normal), 2nd 2.736 vs 2.572. Spec 1.2 PASS all.

conclusions.topic: 395nm vs 365nm Dry UV tension - same or better
conclusions.ni: 161016: Test 1.3103 vs Normal 1.374 = 0.954x, -4.6%. 201507 1st: Test 2.8749 vs Normal 2.503 = 1.148x, +14.9%. 201507 2nd: Test 2.7358 vs Normal 2.5716 = 1.064x, +6.4%. On MSU-L20S15-07 the 395nm machine gives higher tension than 365nm; on 161016 it is marginally lower but well within PASS. All four pairs PASS spec (>=0.5 / 1.2 kgf).

hints.item: On MSU-L20S15-07 line UC PRESS -> 395nm x2 is acceptable, expect +6-15% tension vs 365nm Normal.
hints.why: Test 1st 2.87 vs Normal 2.50; Test 2nd 2.74 vs Normal 2.57, both PASS 1.2 kgf.

hints.item: On 161016 UV film, monitor tension under 395nm; mean drops ~5% but stays >0.5 kgf.

warnings: UV peak/total on 395nm machine an order of magnitude below 365nm; cure depends on bond chemistry not just energy; tension result is the deciding metric here.
log.decision_rationale: Test 395nm vs Normal 365nm same-day same-line tension comparison repeated twice -> process_condition_change with normal_comparison.
